name: 褐翅鴉鵑

iucn.assessmentNote: 全球LC穩定；香港常見留鳥

illustrationTaxon: Centropus sinensis adult, plain unbarred adult plumage

similarSpecies.distinction: 小鴉鵑明顯較小、喙較短，頭胸與肩羽有清晰淡色羽軸紋，背較褐、眼暗；褐翅鴉鵑體型大、尾長，成鳥黑身帶藍紫光，眼紅且翼面橙褐。
雄噪鵑全身黑亮、紅眼但沒有橙褐翼，體形較纖長且樹棲；褐翅鴉鵑更厚重、尾長，具醒目的栗橙翼，常在地面或灌叢行走。

featureNotes: 成年虹膜紅至褐色，喙與腿深灰
成鳥肩、覆羽與飛羽橙褐色，飛羽近端灰色
頭、身及尾呈藍紫金屬光澤，成鳥羽毛素淨
尾長而厚重；成鳥尾、翼及上體不具幼鳥橫斑

rangeMap.note: Partial broad native-range context across the Indian subcontinent east to south China and south through Southeast Asia to the Greater Sundas; country highlights are not nationwide occupancy or exact range polygons. In Hong Kong it is a widespread common resident, chiefly in lowland shrub, grass-shrub, mangrove, agricultural and garden habitats.

sources.use: Full HKBWS Greater Coucal account read: Category I, widespread common resident throughout Hong Kong; typically lowland mangrove and shrub habitats. 47–56 cm; female larger. Adult plain and unbarred, glossy blue/purple-black head/body/tail, orange-brown mantle/scapulars/wing coverts/remiges, red-brown iris, dark grey bill/legs. HK habitats include grassland, grass-shrub, open shrubland, mangrove, farmland, feng-shui woodland and gardens; little evidence of movement/status change. Global IUCN LC, stable trend.

Cornell eBird/Merlin account read: large crow-like/pheasant-like bird with rusty wings, glossy black underparts, long heavy tail and red eyes; juveniles duller with white barring; Greater Coucal larger and longer-billed than Lesser Coucal. Global IUCN LC.

HKBWS Lesser Coucal account read for comparator: 28–34 cm, smaller; pale shaft streaks on head/chest/scapulars, browner and duller back, shorter less deeply based bill, dark eye; common but increasingly localised resident in grass/open shrubland.
Cornell eBird/Merlin Lesser Coucal comparison: significantly smaller, dark eye and duller chestnut wings with silvery streaks; juveniles have barred tail/underparts.
